cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — standing; a small present-day neighborhood outdoor cinema before the screening — she settles into a canvas chair and peels a mandarin for her own snack; a private orbital hotel room with a soft amber bedside reading light and an opaque shuttered window — After a nap she sits up and stretches her legs forward; an empty indoor wave-pool spectator bench after swimming — She shakes trapped water from a removable silicone swimming cap; a present-day public riverside chess terrace on a bright autumn afternoon — she solves a chess endgame on her own; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a rocky coast path with tide pools — standing; a modern rooftop vegetable garden with a shaded dining alcove — She gives a ripe peach a careful first bite while watching the city; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — sitting on the ground; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — writes in a notebook with a pen on the table; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — swimming breaststroke; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — seated sideways on a stool or bench; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — standing
